system.description:
Flurry Technique

As a Bonus action, you can spend 2 Discipline to have your movements accelerated to the point of leaving behind afterimages for a moment. Until the end of the current turn, the first time you deal [Weapon Damage] to a creature as a result of an Attack made with the attack action, you force them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save you inflict one of the following conditions; Bruised, Weakened, Dazzled or Concussed.
